question: By what kinds of attributes can the supreme reality be approached?
premises: The supreme reality can be approached through its attributes.
These include nonconceptuality, firmness, and sovereignty.
Because it is of the nature of power, its attributes inhere in itself.
inference: Therefore the supreme reality may be approached through its own intrinsic attributes as power.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically compressed and continues into the next verse.
plain_english: Therefore, through its own intrinsic attributes as power—such as nonconceptuality, firmness, sovereignty, or others—the supreme reality can be approached.
